plan.requires: Owner approval on 2026-11-14; synthetic tests passing; SHA-256 recorded in the run script before any EEG feature is fitted
plan.question: On held-out list blocks, does the first-fixation waveform tell sentences apart beyond matched noise, shuffled pairs and gaze, and does it survive removing the channels nearest the eyes?
plan.status_of_the_lead: Found as a secondary result in word-locked test v6 on these same blocks: 12.81% against 9.72% for noise at 10-way, with no interval and no gaze control. Retesting on the same data checks whether it survives controls. It cannot confirm it

inputs.source: The v6 word-row cache in data/processed/word_locked_v6_20261106/rows, opened read-only, hashes recorded before freezing. No EEG file is opened. Protected sentences were discarded when the cache was built
inputs.waveform: Raw first-fixation snippet with Cz removed: mean amplitude in 50 ms bins up to 300 ms, 104 channels by 6 bins, 624 values, as in v6
inputs.anterior_removed: The waveform without the 21 channels (20% of 104) with the largest anterior coordinate in the GSN-HydroCel-128 montage of MNE 1.10.2. The next channel lies at 0.045 m and the last removed at 0.0555 m
inputs.gaze: Token length, log training frequency of the token, TRT duration, number of fixations, word position, sentence word count and release flag, as in v6

cache.rows_digest_rule: SHA-256 over each file name in sorted order followed by the SHA-256 of its bytes

inputs.column_order: Bin by bin, with all 104 channels inside each bin, as written by word_rows.waveform_bins

protected.policy: v1 test sentences, v2 test blocks and their buffers are never fitted or scored. A run-time audit refuses to continue otherwise

folds.source: The same 13 held-out blocks as averaged-EEG test v5, with 10 list positions of buffer on each side

arms.gaussian: Matched noise per word, built as in v6 from the waveform features
arms.class_shuffled: Training sentences' word targets permuted by sentence within release, mean of 10 shuffles
arms.gaze_word: Gaze and word properties, no EEG
arms.gaze_plus_real: Gaze features and the real waveform side by side in one ridge. Every column, gaze included, is z-scored per reader from the fold's training rows
arms.gaze_plus_noise: Gaze features and the noise waveform, built the same way
arms.anterior_removed: Real waveform without the anterior channels
arms.anterior_removed_noise: Noise waveform without the anterior channels
arms.partial: Inside each held-out block, remove from real and noise sentence predictions what list position, its square, word count, mean TRT duration and fixated-word count explain linearly. Refits nothing

evaluation.primary: Expected 10-way top-1 within each query's own held-out block, all readers averaged, centred scoring as in v6, equal weight per sentence, ties are misses; chance 10%
secondary: Each 50 ms bin alone, real and noise
Score against reader count: 1, 2, 4, 8 and all, real and noise
Expected 2-way and 4-way within block, real and noise
Expected 2-way, 4-way, 10-way and 24-way against all scored sentences in the release, real and noise

comparisons.beats_nulls: real minus gaussian and real minus class_shuffled

decision_rule.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of sentences and of blocks for every comparison; 2000 of readers within release, recomputing the average, for noise, shuffled pairs, adds-to-gaze and the eye-channel check. Two-sided 95% intervals
decision_rule.clear: Gap at least the minimum and every available lower bound above 0

outcomes.condition: Beats nulls, adds to gaze, survives without the anterior channels and clears the partial check
outcomes.label: The first-fixation waveform carries sentence information beyond noise, gaze and eye channels

outcomes.condition: Beats nulls, and any of the other three does not clear
outcomes.label: The gain does not exceed gaze, eye channels or structure
The first-fixation result did not hold

decision_rule.secondary_scope: Secondary results never change the label
decision_rule.what_a_positive_means: Even the first label is exploratory, because the lead was chosen on these blocks. Confirmation needs data not yet used, which means the v2 test blocks and the owner's decision

refuse_if: The word-row cache's hashes or row counts differ from the plan
A protected sentence reaches a fit or a score
A held-out sentence key, group or signal file appears in that fold's training
A word's text, eye-tracking values or word boxes enter an EEG-only arm's features
Scaling statistics use a held-out row
tests_before_run: A planted waveform signal is recovered and earns the first label
A signal that only follows fixation duration or word length does not earn the first label, over 20 seeds
A signal placed only on the anterior channels does not earn the first label, over 20 seeds
A signal present only at sentence level is not counted by the noise arm
audit.false_pass_check: On synthetic fixtures before freezing, over 20 seeds each: signals following only fixation duration, only word length, or present only on the anterior channels did not earn the first label on any seed. A planted waveform signal earned it, no signal earned the third, and a sentence-level signal did not earn the first

plan.test_policy: No final test data is scored
plan.stop_rule: Stop after this run whatever the outcome. No extra bins, channels, models or settings under this plan. If the result does not hold, decoding work stops
plan.existing_output_policy: Refuse to run if the output directory exists; hash protected prior artifacts before and after
plan.folds_note: The same 13 held-out blocks, buffers, targets, reader scaling and centred scoring as word-locked test v6

model.type: Ridge from word features to word embedding; no word text is an input
model.alpha_selection: Inside each fold's training data only: one seeded contiguous 25-position block per release plus 10 positions each side are held back, scored with the primary metric, then the model is refit on all of that fold's training word rows

sentence_prediction.word_slot: Mean prediction across the readers who fixated that word in that sentence
sentence_prediction.sentence: Mean over the sentence's fixated word slots
